papers.title: Effect of Post-Weld Heat Treatment on Residual Stress and Fatigue Crack Propagation Behavior in Linear Friction Welded Ti-6Al-4V Alloy
papers.abstract: In this study, the effects of post-weld heat treatment (PWHT) on residual stress distribution and fatigue crack propagation (FCP) behavior in linear friction welded (LFW) Ti-6Al-4V joints were investigated. Microstructural evolution in the weld center zone (WCZ), thermomechanically affected zone (TMAZ), heat-affected zone (HAZ), and base metal (BM) was characterized using scanning electron microscropy (SEM) and electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD). Mechanical properties were evaluated via Vickers hardness testing and digital image correlation (DIC)-based tensile testing. Residual stresses before and after PWHT were measured using the contour method. The LFW process introduced significant residual stresses, with tensile stresses up to 709.2 MPa in the WCZ, resulting in non-uniform fatigue crack growth behavior. PWHT at 650 °C and 750 °C effectively reduced these stresses. After PWHT, fatigue cracks propagated uniformly across the weld region, enabling reliable determination of crack growth rates. The average crack growth rates of the heat-treated specimens were comparable to those of the base metal, confirming that PWHT, particularly at 750 °C, stabilizes the fatigue crack path and relieves internal stress.

llm.relevance_to_user: 论文涉及Ti-6Al-4V和焊后热处理，但研究对象为线性摩擦焊接头而非增材制造材料，与L2方向中增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的后处理焦点不匹配。
llm.why_not_core: No additive manufacturing context; focuses on linear friction welded joints, not AM Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究焊后热处理对线性摩擦焊Ti-6Al-4V接头残余应力和疲劳裂纹扩展的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用SEM、EBSD、硬度测试、DIC拉伸、轮廓法测残余应力和疲劳试验。
summary_zh.result: 焊后热处理有效降低残余应力，使疲劳裂纹均匀扩展，速率接近母材。
summary_zh.validation: 通过机械测试和轮廓法残余应力测量验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of post-weld heat treatment on residual stress and fatigue crack propagation in linear friction welded Ti-6Al-4V joints.
summary_en.method: Microstructural characterization, hardness, DIC tensile testing, contour method for residual stress, and fatigue crack growth tests were conducted.
summary_en.result: PWHT at 650°C and 750°C effectively reduced residual stress and stabilized fatigue crack propagation, with rates comparable to base metal.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing and contour method residual stress measurements.
